
{{alias}}( x )
    Evaluates the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation function.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Function value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 0.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    ~0.8413
    > y = {{alias}}( -Infinity )
    -0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( Infinity )
    Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN


{{alias}}.tanh( x )
    Evaluates the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation function using a
    tanh approximation.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Function value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}.tanh( 0.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}.tanh( 1.0 )
    ~0.8412
    > y = {{alias}}.tanh( -Infinity )
    -0.0
    > y = {{alias}}.tanh( Infinity )
    Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}.tanh( NaN )
    NaN


{{alias}}.quick( x )
    Evaluates the Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU) activation function using a
    quick 1.702 approximation.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Function value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}.quick( 0.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}.quick( 1.0 )
    ~0.8458
    > y = {{alias}}.quick( -Infinity )
    -0.0
    > y = {{alias}}.quick( Infinity )
    Infinity
    > y = {{alias}}.quick( NaN )
    NaN

    --------
